The search identified the likely album page but not the full discography table. I’m fetching Mercedes Sosa’s English Wikipedia page to count entries explicitly classified as studio albums from 2000 through 2009.
```python
wiki_page = await web_fetch("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes_Sosa", max_chars=30000)
print(wiki_page)
```
The page content is needed to distinguish studio albums from live and compilation releases, so I’m retrieving the discography section directly.
